title: Mr W. H.
html_source: Mysterious dedicatee of Shakespeare’s sonnets. One school maintains that it refers to William Herbert (Earl of Pembroke), as he was the dedicatee of Billy’s First Folio; however, Wilde’s camp speculate that W.H. is one Willie Hughes, a “faire youth” with whom Shakespeare had a kind of relationship. Many other possibilities have been suggested.
